Zero's administrative HTTP endpoints were registered without authentication, allowing an unauthenticated caller who could reach the HTTP port (default 6080) to take down the control plane via /removeNode. Fixed by commit c32f60413 (2026-07-23), released in 25.4.0. No CVE has been assigned and the advisory is unpublished as of this document's timestamp, so this statement is pre-emptive.
